title: Kepler to Müller, 27 February 1630
author: Johannes Kepler
source: Johannes Kepler's letter to Philipp Müller written at Sagan on 27 February 1630, about sending type and copies of the *Epistolium* from China, with a sharp remark on the war in Germany. The original is in the Bibliothèque nationale, Paris (Nouv. acq. lat. 1635, fol. 98; 89, 8. F. 19), with a copy at fol. 97. First printed in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 73–74.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Kepler sends copies of the letter from China and asks for Müller's judgement, ethical as well as astronomical, with a bitter remark on the portents the war has brought Germany.

notes.note: Frederick Henry of Orange's capture of 's-Hertogenbosch (Bois-le-Duc) in September 1629; *dumetum*, a thicket, renders *bosch*.
Frederick Henry of Orange's capture of 's-Hertogenbosch (Bois-le-Duc) from Spain in September 1629; Kepler's Latin, *de Dumeto*, “of the Thicket”, renders *bosch*.
